subject: R closing when hitting run from the plot builder

messages.author: 31c1235796669f0b
messages.subject: R closing when hitting run from the plot builder
parts:
When hitting run once my plot finished it just closes R (and the plot
builder) without notice. I'm running Deducer from R GUI console
(2.10.1) under windows XP 32, java 1.6.0_21.

I've tried source (i.e. install.packages("Deducer",,"http://
www.rforge.net",type="source") )
And not form source (i.e. install.packages("Deducer") )

Thanks for any help,
Etienne
